issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in next_id() can cause duplicate IDs in concurrent writes
summary: Added file locking mechanism using fcntl.flock to prevent race conditions in concurrent writes. The _lock() context manager acquires an exclusive lock on a separate .lock file before the load -> next_id -> save sequence in TodoApp.add().
risks: File locking uses fcntl which is Unix-only; will not work on Windows
Lock file persists after operations; cleanup not implemented (but harmless)
limitations: Only add() operation uses locking; other operations (mark_done, remove) could also benefit but are lower risk
